display_long_description:
# The Ultimate FREE Stress Relief Sandbox with Multiplayer! 

You and your friends can use light-hearted weapons, devices, superpowers, and more to beat up on your Buddy ragdoll, earn money, and unlock even more powerful weapons. Every moment is packed with absurd over-the-top destruction!

# 50+ Weapons to Unlock
Endlessly satisfying demolition with tons of epic items, physics toys, and boobytraps.
[media]

# Multiplayer Mayhem with Friends
Wreak havoc with friends in public or private lobbies. Unleash a diabolical beatdown on the buddies (or each other).
[media]

# Tons of Awesome Maps and Game Modes to Explore
Let your imagination run wild in a playground of topsy-turvy maps and modes. Set up perfectly for combos, trickshots, and chaos!
[media]

# Non-Stop Content Additions
New weapons, modes, maps, and more keep the surprises coming and fun constantly evolving!

[media]

# Join Our Discord!
Find others to play with, vote on new updates, share your videos (creator programs), and get special access to future releases and giveaways.

**🔗 discord.gg/kyvHv5fYvy**


LuxoticVR – "One of the best free multiplayer Quest games I've found in a while"

Fudgy – "OH MY GOODNESS HIS HEAD ACTUALLY CAME OFF! THAT'S SO COOL!"
